results.detail: The arithmetic is correct: CASE WHEN SUM(ISNULL(bal,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ISNULL(bal,0)*pct)/SUM(ISNULL(bal,0)). A NULL-rate fund counts in the denominator only. The data-dependent outcomes are correctly conditional. All rates NULL with a non-zero sum gives NULL. With both stored values present, Update3 (NULL != x) hits FailComponent (DTSX:7731; Update/Update2 at orders 0-1 come first). Accounts without employers/funds get 0. WRONG: 'שני הערכים השמורים בחשבון' (and 'הערך השמור') attribute the unqualified Gen_employeesweightedmanagementfee / Gen_EmployeesFundsValue in a 3-table query (account, gen_employers, gen_fundmain) to the account, with no argument.
